dataset.source: Exact P110 build1 bytes and ordered unique quality roots; no generation or reference
dataset.labels: Single complete quality root per example; no relabeling or target-dependent features

model.initialization: Two sequential cold same-seed models; exact initial logical weights across arms; checkpoint loads zero

input.control: Set occupied plane channel 0 to literal FP32 zero in both common and residual branches; preserve item planes
input.unchanged: All ordered features, metadata, footprints, targets, architecture, seed, loss, optimizer, order, update count and selection
input.excluded: No descriptor, family, arm, coordinate key, reference evaluation or paths enter forward

fit.loss: Mean native FP32 flat cross_entropy over original 32 candidates; unique quality root target
fit.order: Original P110 descriptor order; one optimizer step after all 32 per-example backward calls
fit.selection: Final step 1000 only; original first-index argmax; no early stopping, extra seed, sweep or tuning

resources.runtime: Existing local CPU PyTorch only; no install/GPU/service

validation.beforeExecution: Separate explicit user decision, new execution config/source hashes and clean commit; original proposal preserved
validation.beforeCandidate: Control technical/hash/budget/repeat checks PASS; its expected quality failure is not a technical STOP
validation.sharedInitial: Initial logical weight hashes exact across arms; initial logits are NOT expected equal with different planes
validation.nativePointwise: For each counterfactual pair, require exact FP32 identity of both opposing target inputs, bitwise-equal native scores for each anchor across the pair, and unchanged relative first-index tie priority. Require control top1 <=16/32. Global non-anchor input-class drift is reported without changing scores or applying tolerances.
validation.counting: Durable pre-call global/arm/phase ledger; top-level calls include initial/training/final repeats, no extra warmup or telemetry
validation.stop: Nonfinite/input/hash/schema/initial weights/ledger/repeat/resource mismatch STOP; no retry or tuning

acceptance.technical: Budget and exact repeated final logits checked separately from fit gates
acceptance.interpretation: Full fit PASS with control ceiling validates occupancy availability for this fixed fit-only task, not residual mechanism, independent generalization, original CNN error resolution or app adoption

revision.onlyScientificContractChange: Required native identity scope: opposing target anchors within each pair
revision.globalDrift: Measure every identical-input class, signed-zero/ULP gaps and target occurrence counts; diagnostic only outside required anchors
revision.targetPairScoreEquality: Bitwise exact; one ULP target difference still STOP
revision.proof: Both opposite target inputs occur in both original ordered lists; each anchor's score is equal across that pair; tie priority has same relative order. Both opposite targets cannot win first-index argmax. Sixteen disjoint pairs imply at most16 correct.
revision.candidate: Unchanged original planes, inputs and gates; initial logical weights exact to fresh control; initial logits not forced equal

execution.freshAttempt: New explicit approval required after P115 STOP; no reuse of unused V1 budget
